integrity: The fresh SRKT paper was inspected at the kernel identity, quotient-distance formula, equality problem, and explicit bounded-example question. The necessity proof was reconstructed from compact kernel attainment, a Möbius normalization of the norming kernel, the checked minimal-norm Hankel theorem, and the classical finite-rank rationality theorem. The converse, rank formula, norming-kernel set, and strict uniform-norm gap were verified directly. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to nonzero finite-rank Hardy-space Hankel operators. It does not classify compact infinite-rank or general BMOA symbols, and it does not answer the separate unbounded-example question.
title: Shifted-Blaschke classification of finite-rank SRKT Hankel operators
